title: private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-04-27
content:
Weekly sync notes - ACME private deployment (VPC / on-prem) - 2026-04-27

Attendees: Maya Chen (RWD), David Lopez (RWD), Priya Ramesh (RWD), Tom Barlow (RWD), Rajesh Patel (ACME Infra), Lina Gomez (ACME Security)

Agenda:
- Quick status roundup (what's done / in progress)
- Current blockers (network, KMS/HSM, install)
- Performance validation plan (latency / throughput / NVMe config)
- Rollout timeline alignment + cutover checklist
- Action items and owners

Status roundup:
- VPN/VPC peering: ACME reported partial VPC peering established between production VPC and RWD transit VPC. Static routes still missing for two subnets (app-subnet-3, cache-subnet).
- KMS/HSM: ACME ordered HSM appliance; ETA 2026-05-04. Meanwhile we will use customer-managed KMS key in cloud for staging.
- Installer / on-prem package: initial install succeeded on node-1 (validation env). node-2 failed due to missing kernel module (af_kv_cache). SRE working on kernel rebuild.
- Observability agent: fluentd + otel collector deployed in validation cluster; missing logs for nvme health.
- Model artifacts: model v1.3 quantized bundles uploaded to ACME artifact repo; size verified.

Blockers (priority):
1) Network static routes not fully in place (blocks cross-subnet KV cache replication) — Blocker severity: high — ACME network owner: Rajesh Patel. Required: BGP route advertisement + firewall rule for 10.40.0.0/16 -> 10.50.0.0/16.
2) Kernel module 'af_kv_cache' missing on node-2 — severity: medium-high — Owner: ACME infra (Rajesh) + RWD SRE (Tom) pairing to test kernel config.
3) HSM delivery slip (ETA moved to 05-04) — affects key rotation/cert pinning for production. Temporary mitigation: use cloud KMS for first canary. Owner: Lina Gomez (ACME Security) + Maya (RWD) to sign off.
4) Performance test harness missing NVMe health metrics (affects baseline perf) — Owner: David Lopez (RWD Observability) to extend collector.

Decisions from meeting:
- Proceed with canary using cloud KMS for first 48h after cutover; full HSM integration targeted for 2026-05-10.
- Allow node-2 kernel rebuild window on 2026-04-29 02:00-05:00 UTC (maintenance window confirmed by ACME).
- Delay KV cache replication test until static routes confirmed; run local caching smoke tests instead.

Action items (owner — due):
- Rajesh Patel (ACME): Add static routes + firewall rules for app-subnet-3/cache-subnet and confirm BGP advertisement — due 2026-04-29.
- Tom Barlow (RWD SRE): Coordinate kernel module rebuild on node-2, produce short runbook for ACME to replicate if needed — due 2026-04-28.
- David Lopez (RWD Observability): Update otel collector config to surface NVMe SMART metrics, add dashboard panel for nvme latency/health — due 2026-04-30.
- Maya Chen (RWD PM): Prepare cutover checklist for canary (cloud KMS) and runbook for rollback, link to Confluence page — due 2026-05-01.
- Lina Gomez (ACME Security): Confirm HSM test plan and provide temporary KMS key rotation schedule for canary — due 2026-04-30.
- Priya Ramesh (RWD Deploy): Validate model v1.3 inference correctness on node-1 and produce short regression notes (prompt set + metrics) — due 2026-04-29.

Risks / Mitigations:
- Risk: If static routes delayed beyond 04-29, KV cache replication and some end-to-end tests will be blocked, potentially pushing production cutover. Mitigation: run degraded-mode tests that skip replication; maintain detailed checklist for re-run after network fix.
- Risk: HSM slip causes security sign-off delay. Mitigation: pre-approve cloud KMS usage for initial canary with limited TTL keys and audit logging enabled.

Notes / misc:
- ACME asked for rough cost estimate for NVMe-backed nodes vs. instance-local SSD. Action: Maya to follow up with infra cost modeling (Tom + David) — due 2026-05-03.
- Added Jira tickets: JIRA-4521 (network routes), JIRA-4580 (kernel module), see linked_artifacts.

Next steps / next meeting:
- Next weekly sync: 2026-05-04 16:00 UTC (tentative) — focus: HSM arrival and canary plan finalization.
- If static routes are fixed earlier, schedule mid-week shortcheck to kick off KV replication tests.

Quick follow-up (notes to self):
- Draft cutover rollback playbook: include DNS flush steps, routing toggles, model traffic split (10% -> 50% -> 100%), TTLs.
- Confirm access for RWD deploy agent account on ACME internal artifact repo (SSH key exchange).
- Add an item to run a 30-minute load test (100 concurrent streams) once NVMe metrics are available.
summary: Weekly sync notes for ACME private deployment: outstanding network and kernel blockers; HSM delayed; use cloud KMS for initial canary; action items assigned with owners and due dates.
